posts.title: Amiga 3000 - Quick Connect Guide
posts.description: One thing I really miss from the Commodore Amiga era is the care that went into the printed material that came with the machine. Back in the 80s, opening a new computer box felt like opening a complete system, not just a device. You didn’t only get the computer, power supply, mouse, and cables.
